stageMeta.title: Workspace FS: the first real Tool
headerComment: # Stage 03 — Workspace FS: the first real Tool
# L3 = L2 + FS.  Every plugin from Stage 02 is still here — the agent can
# still resume across process restarts — plus the FS capability seam:
#   dsh-fs-observation-policy  tracks which files the model has observed
#   dsh-tool-fs                Consumer: read / write / edit tool schemas
# Cordis dependency injection in one sentence:
#   Provider makes ctx.fs appear; Consumer declares a dependency on ctx.fs;
#   when the dependency is satisfied, Consumer activates and registers the
#   tool schemas onto ctx.tools — giving the model the ability to read and
#   write files.  Without the Provider, ctx.fs is absent and dsh-tool-fs
#   stays pending (it never finishes registering).  Without the Consumer,
#   ctx.fs works but the model has no tool to call it.
# dsh-tool-fs registers read / write / edit (and conditionally read_image),
# NOT a read-only subset.  This stage is a Workspace FS Agent — the model
# can produce real file side effects.  Search tools (glob / grep) are a
# separate plugin (dsh-tool-fs-search) that depends on ctx.subprocess;
stageMeta.driverQuestion: Read the file src/calculator.js and explain what it does. Be concise.
